basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old outdoor enthusiast based in Minnesota. I've been passionate about firearms and long-range shooting since my early twenties, which led me to join Reddit to share experiences and gather insights from fellow enthusiasts. When I'm not outdoors, I'm an IT consultant, juggling between coding and client meetings. I'm single and spend most of my online hours in the evening, usually after 9 PM, engaging with communities that resonate with my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in firearms and optics, having learned through hands-on experience and online research. I regularly attend shooting workshops and follow industry news to keep my knowledge up-to-date. My IT background also helps me understand the technical aspects of new technologies in the firearm industry.
